papers.title: REFRAMED: Towards Realistic Audio Description Generation for Movies
papers.authors: Igor Sterner, Mirella Lapata, Alex Lascarides, Frank Keller
papers.tags: multimodal learning, scene understanding, visual grounding
papers.affiliations: School of Informatics, University of Edinburgh, United Kingdom
papers.intro: 本文重新定义了音频描述生成任务，要求模型联合决策“描述什么”和“何时描述”，并构建了高质量的电影AD数据集REFramed和配套基准，系统评估了现有AD系统与多模态大语言模型的性能。

papers.title: HandSplatter: Automated Digital Goniometry from Neural Rendering
papers.authors: Emmett Chen, Neal Chen, Xiang Li, Quanzheng Li, Siyeop Yoon
papers.affiliations: Massachusetts General Hospital
papers.intro: 本文提出一种名为HandSplatter的自动化数字测角流水线，通过高斯泼溅神经渲染重建手部三维点云，结合2D特征提取与离散密度爬山算法，实现高精度的手部关节定位和角度测量，以替代传统手动角度计。

papers.title: LookAgain: Closed-Loop GUI Grounding with Visually Grounded Reflection
papers.authors: Renshan Zhang, Haoyang Meng, Yixiao He, Rui Shao, April Hua Liu, Liqiang Nie
papers.affiliations: Harbin Institute of Technology, Shenzhen; Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications; Shenzhen Loop Area Institute; Shanghai University of Finance and Economics
papers.intro: 论文提出LookAgain，一种由“视觉接地反思”驱动的闭环GUI接地球器，将接地从一次性坐标回归重构为多轮“预测–再看–精修”过程，并通过SFT+GRPO两阶段训练实现。

papers.title: Diffuse the object, keep its label: curating detector training data from a few unlabeled photographs via VLM-built 3D vegetation scenes
papers.authors: Mario Malizia, Marnix Enting, Rob Haelterman, Ken Hasselmann
papers.tags: object detection, diffusion model, image generation
papers.affiliations: Royal Military Academy, Brussels, Belgium; KU Leuven, Leuven, Belgium; Flanders Make, Heverlee, Belgium
papers.intro: 论文提出一种从少量未标注现场照片合成带标签检测训练数据的流水线：用VLM生成粗略3D植被场景，在其中放置3D物体网格获得精确标签，再通过LoRA微调的扩散模型进行背景重纹理，并用分级掩膜锁定（mask-lock）保护物体区域，从而在不依赖跨场地标注数据的前提下训练出可匹配或超越真实数据训练的检测器。

papers.title: Thinking With Tools, Not With Pixels: Tool Calls as Text Scaffolds for Visual Reasoning
papers.authors: Jiahao Shao, Yuanbo Yang, Yiyi Liao, Yujun Shen, Ceyuan Yang, Yinghao Xu
papers.affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Ant Group, Zhejiang University
papers.intro: 论文提出 TextCall（call-but-no-return）干预，在训练和推理时保留工具调用的结构化文本脚手架（工具名、坐标、目标描述、意图）但将返回图像替换为固定文本占位符，从而证明在当前 thinking-with-images 分布下，负载信号是工具调用时发出的文本脚手架而非返回的像素。

papers.title: You Only Flow Once: Calibrated and Real-Time Radar Pose Estimation with Multi-Hypothesis Normalizing Flows
papers.authors: Jonas Leo Mueller, Sebastian Hoefler, Dario Zanca, Naga Venkata Sai Jitin Jami, Thomas Altstidl, Bjoern M. Eskofier
papers.affiliations: Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg; Munich Center for Machine Learning (MCML); LMU München; Helmholtz Zentrum München
papers.intro: 本文提出MH-NFPG，利用条件归一化流将雷达点云映射为校准的多假设3D姿态分布，通过单次前向传播实现实时推理，并在精度和校准上超越扩散模型。

papers.title: A Height-Constrained 2-Point Minimal Solver for Pose Estimation from Active LED Markers with Event Cameras
papers.authors: Runze Yuan, Alexander Kappler, Jun Zhang, Kuangyi Chen, Fabio Morbidi, Pascal Vasseur, Cédric Demonceaux, Friedrich Fraundorfer
papers.affiliations: Graz University of Technology（Institute of Visual Computing）；University of Picardie Jules Verne（MIS laboratory）；University of Burgundy Europe（ICB laboratory）
papers.intro: 本文推导了一种仅利用两个LED标记点、结合已知倾斜角和相机高度的最小位姿求解器（高度约束P2P），通过闭式解和线性最小二乘两种方式唯一确定相机位姿，并在合成和真实数据上验证了其相对于现有P2P/P3P方法的优越性。

papers.title: CableDex: Cable Length Estimation on Industrial Reels Using a Handheld Device
papers.authors: Francisco Guillén, Ricardo Almeida, Bruno Silva, João C. Neves
papers.affiliations: Francisco Guillén - University of Beira Interior, NOVA-LINCS UBI, Portugal Bruno M. C. Silva - University of Beira Interior, IT - Instituto de Telecomunicações, Portugal João Neves - University of Beira Interior, NOVA-LINCS UBI, Portugal
papers.intro: CableDex是一个结合相机标定、实例分割、位姿估计和体积计算的端到端计算机视觉系统，可从单张手机照片中估计工业线盘上的电缆剩余长度，在5种线盘类型75次实测中达到4.90%的平均绝对百分比误差（MAPE），满足工业界10%的误差容忍标准。

papers.title: LightAIR: Lightweight Action Inversion and Riemannian Rectification for Text-based Person Anomaly Search
papers.authors: Yulun Zhang, Zixu Li, Zhiwei Chen, Zhiheng Fu, Wenbo Wang, Zihang Qiu, Zhilin Wang, Ruxin Wang, Yupeng Hu
papers.affiliations: Shenzhen Institutes of Advanced Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences; Shandong University
papers.intro: LightAIR通过引入文本语义先验作为锚点、利用正交零空间投影实现前向解耦、并采用黎曼梯度修正切断反向传播中的有害捷径，从而在无外部姿态估计器的情况下显著提升了文本行人异常搜索的性能。

papers.title: Multi-Submap Implicit Neural SLAM with Local-to-Global Loop Closure for Large-Scale Scene Reconstruction
papers.authors: Tianchen Deng, Chongdi Wang, Nailin Wang, Lei Zhao, Ziqi Ma, Tianjun Zhang, Zhe Liu, Danwei Wang, Hesheng Wang
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, NeRF, depth estimation, scene understanding
papers.affiliations: 上海交通大学（School of Automation and Intelligent Sensing, Shanghai Jiao Tong University）、卡内基梅隆大学（Carnegie Mellon University）、南洋理工大学（Nanyang Technological University）
papers.intro: 本文提出 MSN-SLAM，一种基于多子地图（multi-submap）的隐式神经 SLAM 系统，通过渐进式子地图分配、局部到全局回环闭合和子地图间在线蒸馏，在保持内存可控的同时实现大规模室内外场景的一致高保真重建与鲁棒位姿估计。

papers.title: Visual Distortion Detection in UGC Images Using Large Multimodal Models
papers.authors: Ziheng Jia, Yingji Liang, Jiaying Qian, Xiongkuo Min
papers.affiliations: 1Shanghai Jiao Tong University, 2East China Normal University
papers.intro: 提出VIGIL，一个基于LMM架构的局部失真检测模型，通过构建大规模合成失真训练集VIGIL-140K、利用LLM多层作为同步检测器，并保留背景类预测中的失真线索，显著提升了域内合成失真检测和S2A泛化能力。

papers.title: Guardian Crawler: Retrieval-First Knowledge Discovery with Bounded LLM Augmentation for Noisy Web Intelligence
papers.authors: Joshua Castillo, Santosh Nukavarapu, Ravi Mukkamala
papers.affiliations: Department of Computer Science, Old Dominion University
papers.intro: Guardian Crawler 提出了一个基于合成 mini-web 的可复现、模块化检索优先测试平台，结合 BM25 检索与风险感知、嵌入增强和混合重排序，并通过受限的 RAG 生成带引用的摘要，从而在噪声网络智能任务中实现可控的、有证据依据的知识发现。

papers.title: Integrated Multimodal AI System for Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning, Object Sensing, and Damage Analysis
papers.authors: Kalelo Dukuray, Israel Pina, Evan Perez, Erika Ardiles-Cruz, Jie Wei
papers.affiliations: City College of New York（Dept. of Computer Science）；Air Force Research Lab（Rome, NY）
papers.intro: 论文提出并验证了一个集成了向量与知识图谱RAG、红外/可见光融合目标检测与分割、以及无线信号感知的统一多模态AI系统，用于在复杂与极端条件下实现更鲁棒、可解释和准确的损伤评估。

papers.title: A Dynamic-Semantics Framework for Grounding Human Referring Expressions in Visual Perceptual Data
papers.authors: Joseph Bingham
papers.tags: visual grounding, image retrieval, multimodal learning, video search
papers.affiliations: Department of Biology, Technion University, Haifa, IL（以色列）
papers.intro: 论文提出一个将词汇趋同中的“约定状态”外部化为Γ、Ξ、Ω三个显式集合的动态语义框架，并通过SIFT单应变换和UQI相似度把人类指称表达与抽象tangram图像进行感知对齐，在Stanford重复参考游戏语料上实现了单次话语下83.56%的top-5识别准确率。

papers.title: Your VLM Already Knows When: Training-Free Temporal Grounding by Asking Yes or No
papers.authors: Ji Huang, Barry Devereux, Hui Wang
papers.affiliations: Queen's University Belfast
papers.intro: 论文证明VLM时间定位失败的根本原因在任务接口（直接回归时间戳）而非感知能力，并提出免训练的FV-Action方法，通过冻结VLM回答二元“是与否”问题并进行粗细扫描，显著提升时间定位性能。

papers.title: Search over the Visual World: Persistent Visual Memory, Layered Indexes, and Source-Grounded Evidence
papers.authors: Sankalp Nagaonkar, Rohit Garg, Ankit Raj, Ashish Choithani, Ashutosh Trivedi
papers.affiliations: VideoDB
papers.intro: 论文提出了一种搜索视觉世界的概念与形式化模型——通过持久视觉记忆、分层索引和源接地证据，并以VideoDB数据格式（VDB）作为生产级参考实现，证明在视觉检索中系统设计比视频专属预训练更能决定最终检索质量。

papers.title: Vision-Language Grounding as Bidirectional Concept Correspondence
papers.authors: Jieyu Zhang, Ziqi Gao, Luke Zettlemoyer, Ranjay Krishna
papers.tags: visual grounding, semantic segmentation, instance segmentation, object detection
papers.affiliations: University of Washington; Allen Institute for AI; FAIR at Meta
papers.intro: 论文将视觉语言接地重新定义为图像-文本对之间的双向概念对应，并提出ConCor-1模型，利用可学习桥接标记联合预测文本掩码、图像掩码和对应存在性，在长描述和零样本大词汇量接地任务上显著优于现有基线。

papers.title: Keep It Simple: Multi-Key Episodic Memory Retrieval for Ultra-Long Video Understanding
papers.authors: Yeeun Choi, Youngbeom Yoo, Joon-Young Lee, Hyolim Kang, Seon Joo Kim
papers.affiliations: Yonsei University; Adobe Research
papers.intro: MERIT提出一种极简的“多键情节记忆+推理时邻居过滤”框架，在记忆构建阶段仅保留高召回率的轻量索引，将高层语义组合推迟到查询时，从而在超长视频问答上实现高效且最优的性能。

papers.title: SABRE: Scalable and Automated Benchmarking of VLMs under Stress
papers.authors: Zixuan Lan, Luzhe Sun, Matthew R. Walter, Jiawei Zhou
papers.affiliations: University of Chicago; Toyota Technological Institute at Chicago; Stony Brook University
papers.intro: 本文提出SABRE——一个可扩展、自动化的VLM压力测试构建流水线，能够将用户用Markdown写的任务设计（Test Primer）自动转化为结构化的样本规范、生成或编辑的图像以及问答对，并通过自动过滤和人工审核生成高质量、可持续更新的压力测试基准。

papers.title: Conformal Coverage Guarantees for Any Video Temporal Grounder
papers.authors: Aseel Mohamed, Rasul Khanbayov, Erchin Serpedin, Hasan Kurban
papers.affiliations: Texas A&M University at Qatar; Hamad Bin Khalifa University; Texas A&M University
papers.intro: Cover是一种模型无关的后处理包装器，通过在校准集上对时间非一致性分数进行分位数校准并扩展基础预测，使任何视频时序定位器（训练好的局部器或黑盒视频-语言模型）输出的时间区域以至少1−α的概率包含真实时刻，且无需重训练或白盒访问。
